section.title: Todo list
section.subtitle: A throttled reminder about open tasks
field.enabled.label: Remind me about open tasks every so many rounds
field.enabled.help: When on, once the todo list has not been updated for the set number of rounds and still has open items, a reminder is appended to the request. On by default (in long tasks this is the step models forget most often).
field.everyRounds.label: Rounds between reminders
field.everyRounds.help: One round = one model request. Smaller values remind more often and cost more tokens; it only takes effect while the switch above is on.
save.outOfRange: The interval must be between 1 and 100.
save.unknownKey: This section has no such setting: {key}
